releases.title: First production release
highlights: Never lose a day — the recall engine rebuilds missed nutrition, activity, and sleep days from your child's own patterns, always marked as estimates.
Trust calendar — see exactly which days are measured vs estimated, and confirm or correct any of them.
Smarter analytics — week-over-week deltas, trend direction, a growth chart with a habit-scenario band, and a research-weighted readiness score personalized to your child.
Pediatric visit summary PDF — a clean, printable report for your doctor (Premium).
Sign in with Google or Apple, plus password reset.
